name: attendance-app
description: Attendance & payroll tracking app (web + iOS via Capacitor)

scripts.build:www: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp -R index.html css js manifest.json sw.js icons splash favicon.ico www/
scripts.ios:add: npm run build:www && npx cap add ios
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:www && npx cap sync ios
